frozenAtStage: numeric analysis and deterministic event selection are frozen before audio asset creation

interpretation.implementationFact: At each physics step, each layer contributes its existing stereo point-readout multiplied by PLATE_PICKUP_MIX. Sphere contributions are aggregated separately and multiplied by MIX. Their signed sum is the existing pre-limiter mix; one existing soft limiter then feeds the existing interpolator.
interpretation.experimentResult: Metrics below describe readout contributions in one unchanged full coupled replay. Rest-of-world Plate signal is the signed samplewise sum of all Plate pickup stems except the focal layer.
interpretation.artisticInterpretation: No perceptual judgment was collected. Energy, contributor concentration, and ERB similarity are descriptive readout measurements, not a psychoacoustic masking criterion.
interpretation.stemMeaning: A Plate stem is that layer’s point pickup in the full coupled solve, including state caused by Plate/Z/Nodule interaction. It is not a render of an isolated physical Plate.

method.energy: sum(L^2 + R^2) across physics samples; RMS is sqrt(energy / (2 * sample count))
method.physicsWindowAlignment: Energy windows begin at the first 6 kHz physics sample after the exact routed event frame; event frames can fall between physics steps. ERB and listening excerpts remain aligned to the exact 48 kHz event frame.
method.exactSupport: Per-step count of Plate stems whose captured Float64 L or R is exactly nonzero; no amplitude cutoff.
method.majority: Largest single Plate share > 0.5 is a strict arithmetic majority, not a masking threshold.
method.eventDensity: Count of routed strike messages and unique FOOT_CONTACT groups starting in [event frame, event frame + window).
method.limiter: Common gain is 1/(1+abs(full pre-limiter channel sample)); full post value is worklet output after that limiter and 48 kHz interpolation.
method.erb: Existing 30-band ERB Hann-STFT frontend, unit-sum shape metrics; cosine/TV describe spectral overlap only.

globalLimiterByEffectiveContributorQuart.quartileDefinition: equal-sized ranked quarters; ties retain all rows in stable order
